item.title: Sjta 2025 09 02
item.description:
विश्वास-टिप्पनी - HBV

Gajapati said one could do it any day within the 9-day duration. They still prefer to disobey it.

Sjta could’ve cited HBV 14.327 to make their case.
Otherwise, purANa verses can be interpreted to specifically apply to puri.

In Vilāsa 14, Verse 327 (numbered as 14.104 in some editions), Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī instructs that specific festivals of Lord Jagannātha must be celebrated in exact alignment with the dates and timings observed at the Mūla-pīṭha in Jagannātha Purī:
